description: This file defines an abstract class SugarObjectType in the SuiteCRM enumeration namespace. It contains constants representing different object types used in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SugarObjectType
classes.description: An abstract class containing constants that define various object types within SuiteCRM, such as basic, company, file, issue, person, and sale.
